description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Lelwala, Neluwa D/S Division, Galle District - (25-14-204-00014)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations regarding specific land parcels. It involves declarations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement about land ownership, parcel numbers, and registration details under the Registration of Title Act. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including land registrations, property ownership, and land titles, which matches the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
